hyperv.thisIsVpnerVirtualMachine:
This is a VPNer virtual machine.

1. Install your VPN program here (AmneziaVPN, Cisco Secure Client and so on).
   Download the installer in Firefox or send it from VPNer:
   “Connections” -> this VM’s card -> “Send a file” (the file appears in the “Files from VPNer” folder on the desktop).
2. Connect the VPN in the program as usual.
3. VPNer sees the tunnel by itself and starts sending traffic here by your rules.

Protection: the gateway service can send traffic ONLY through the VPN program’s tunnel.
If the VPN disconnects, traffic of this VM’s rules is blocked instead of going out directly.
